title: ExternalEvidence
description: Append-only ledger of external tool calls (Scite, PubTator3, OpenAlex, PubMed, Exa, Crossref) made during an audit. Each entry records the canonicalized query, a SHA-256 query_hash for cache lookup, the fetched_at timestamp, and a structured response_digest (≤512 chars). Stages 2-4 route every external call through scripts/external_evidence.lookup_or_fetch so retraction / venue / entity probes are memoized within freshness windows (see thresholds.ARTIFACT_FRESHNESS_DAYS). Validated by scripts/validate_artifact.py --kind external_evidence against schema + predicates E1/E2/E3. Cross-artifact predicate R5 (validate_audit_report.py) enforces that every probe step in audit_report.findings[].verification_path[] has a corresponding ledger entry.

opened_at.description: When the ledger file was first created for this audit. Entries[] are appended chronologically thereafter.

entries.description: Append-only. Entries are added in fetched_at order; E3 emits an advisory warning if any pair is out-of-order.

id.description: Sequential per-audit ID, zero-padded to at least 4 digits (E0001, E0002, ...).

tool.description: Source tool the call routed through. Mirrors keys of thresholds.ARTIFACT_FRESHNESS_DAYS.

method.description: Tool-specific method label (e.g. 'scite_context', 'pubtator3_entity_check', 'openalex_venue_quality'). R5 uses this to match verification_path[] steps to ledger entries.

query_hash.description: SHA-256 hex (lowercase) of canonicalized query_params (sorted keys, lowercase string values, JSON serialization). Drives cache lookup.

query_params.description: Free-form per-tool params (doi, pmid, query string, etc.). Stored verbatim for diagnostic readability; the cache key is query_hash, not this field.

paper_id.description: DOI-preferred join key when the call is paper-scoped (matches resolved_sources.sources[].paper_id). Null for non-paper calls (e.g. free-text Exa search).

fetched_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the actual tool call (not of cache reuse). TTL comparison in lookup_or_fetch uses this field.

response_digest.description: Structured summary of the tool response, capped at 512 chars. Per-tool conventions documented in stage prose. Not the raw response body.

consumed_by_findings.description: Finding IDs (claim_inventory.json items[].id format) that reused this entry. Populated via external_evidence.record_consumption as stages reuse cached probes.
